verdict.rationale: YPOG has an IP/IT/Data Protection practice page advising founders/startups/investors on building and realizing IP assets, and separately mentions clarifying IP issues around NFTs, but there is no specific mention of trademark clearance, registration, or brand enforcement as a documented service or sub-practice. Missing for 10: explicit trademark clearance/search services, trademark registration/prosecution work, brand enforcement/anti-counterfeiting practice, or a named trademark team/partner.
